sentences.text:
This is an application for regular bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed by the sole accused in Crime No.1461/2022 of Kalamassery Police Station, Ernakulam registered under Sections 376(3) of IPC and Sections 3 r/w 4(1), 5(1) r/w 6(1) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO Act).
2. The prosecution allegation is that during the period 01.07.2022 to 31.08.2022, the petitioner sexually assaulted and committed rape on the survivor girl aged 16.

sentences.text: 3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner and the survivor girl were intimate friends for quite long, and he never did any sexual assault against the survivor girl, and he is absolutely innocent.
He is ready to abide by any conditions imposed by this Court.
He was arrested on 16.01.2023 and is in judicial custody since 23.01.2023.
6. On instructions, learned Public Prosecutor submitted that investigation has progressed substantially and final report will be filed soon.
Learned Public Prosecutor expressed apprehension that if he is released on bail, he may abscond to Assam.
So, he may not be available for trial.

7. But, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner and his family are settled in Kerala for long, and he will not leave the limits of Kerala without getting permission from the trial court.
The petitioner was aged only 20 years at the time of alleged incident and he was in a friendly relationship with the survivor girl.

In such circumstances, this court is inclined to allow this application on the following conditions:-
(i). The petitioner shall be released on bail on executing bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties (at least one of the surety shall be having property in Kerala) each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial court.

(ii). The petitioner shall report before the investigating officer, on alternate Saturdays, starting from 23.03.2024 for a period of three months or till the final report is filed, whichever is earlier.
(iii) The petitioner shall not enter the limits of Kalamassery police station, where the victim girl is residing with family, except for the purpose of appearing before the Investigating Officer.
(iv). The petitioner shall not contact the victim or her family members and shall not cause any kind of harassment to them, either directly or indirectly.
(v). The petitioner shall not influence or intimidate the witnesses or tamper with the investigation.
(vi). The petitioner has to surrender his passport before the arresting officer at the time of executing bond and if he is not having a passport, he has to file an affidavit to that effect.
